integrity: The theorem is given with complete proof and standalone standard-library verifier. The finite certificate is replayable, not an assertion of independent validation. No unperformed independent audit is implied.
scientific_limitations: The proof treats simple toroidal Cartesian product graphs C4 square Cn with n>=6 and the ordinary four-cut Alexander dual. It makes no integral homotopy assertion for the original cut complex, shorter cycles, other widths or equivariance. The all-parameter argument uses a finite local collapse certificate and a locality lemma, not bounded extrapolation. Equivalent unindexed literature remains possible.
title: Integral sphere-wedge topology of toroidal ordinary four-cut complexes
